newsitem.title: FRANCE: Police detain striking doctors at Paris protest.
newsitem.headline: Police detain striking doctors at Paris protest.

text.p: Police said they briefly detained 14 striking junior hospital doctors on Friday after a demonstration in Paris against government plans to limit welfare spending.
More than 100 doctors had staged a rally before police moved in and led 14 of the protesters away, handcuffing several after scuffles with police.
They were released from custody in the early evening. Police said several of those detained may be charged with staging an illegal demonstration and insulting a police officer.

Unions this week suspended a five-week strike and said their action would continue but take a different form. They have called a national demonstration on April 24 and plan to stop billing patients from that day.

A small minority of the junior practitioners have refused to give up the strike. Junior hospital doctors are protesting against state plans to fine doctors exceeding preset spending targets in order to plug the gaping welfare deficit.
